name: CDC-recognized lifestyle-change diabetes prevention program (National DPP) for adults with prediabetes
appliesWhen: The marginal gift funds additional enrolled adults in a year-long group lifestyle program following the CDC National DPP curriculum (YMCA, community health centers, health departments).
Participants are adults with prediabetes or high risk; not children.
doesNotApplyWhen: The program is a one-off nutrition class, food distribution, or diabetes self-management education for people who already have diabetes.
The gift funds a cohort an insurer (Medicare MDPP, Medicaid, employer plan) would otherwise pay for, unless fundingAdditionality reflects that.

nativeOutcome.unit: discounted kg-years of incremental weight loss
nativeOutcome.notes: Weight loss relative to an offer-only control, summed over the years it persists. Diabetes cases averted would be a better native unit; v1 keeps the SF model's weight pathway.

qalyBridge.notes: Observational association of weight change with EQ-5D utility. Excludes diabetes-avoidance QALYs beyond what utility captures, so likely conservative for high-risk cohorts and generous for low-risk ones.

costPerParticipant.label: Donor cost per additional enrolled participant

preferredSources: Provider's per-participant price or grant budget
Medicare MDPP performance-payment schedule for the price year (an upper-bound reimbursement anchor, not cost)
lookup.fallback: SF distribution scaled by the local/SF BLS wage ratio for health educators, labeled transferred judgment.
lookup.judgmentGuide: SF $200/$600/$1,200; central $600 is a judgment, not a YMCA quote.

fundingAdditionality.label: Share of donor-funded enrollment that would not otherwise be funded

preferredSources: Whether the state Medicaid program covers National DPP
Whether the dominant local public employer/insurer pays the provider
lookup.judgmentGuide: SF 0.2/0.5/0.8 reflected Medi-Cal DPP coverage and an SF Health Service System YMCA partnership. Lower it where coverage is broad; raise it where payers do not cover DPP.

transfer.label: Retention of trial effect in the local population and provider

preferredSources: Provider's CDC DPRP recognition status (full plus vs pending)
Local cohort completion and weight-loss outcomes

extraKg.label: Additional weight loss versus offer-only control

default.rationale: Randomized YMCA offer trial, with scenario spread.

sources.title: Ackermann et al.: randomized YMCA offer trial

discountedRetentionYears.label: Discounted years over which the weight difference persists

default.rationale: Sum over years t of retention[t]/1.03^(t+0.5) for the SF retention profiles [0.25,0.25], [0.5,1,0.75,0.25] and [0.5,1,1,1,1,0.5]. Embeds the 3% discount convention; a v2 template should split persistence from discounting.

sources.title: Kuo et al.: prospective NDPP cost and QALY analysis

utilityPerKg.label: QALY weight gain per kg of weight loss per year

sources.title: Ackermann et al.: weight change and health utility

excludedEffects: Diabetes cases averted beyond the utility association
Program harms (set to zero in SF)
nullBoundary: If the cohort would have been funded anyway or weight loss does not persist, benefit is zero and there is no finite price.

origin.reproduces: At all p50 inputs, reproduces the SF central $2,095,452 per 10 QALYs. Change: the variable-length retention arrays become one derived scalar, and harmQalys (0 in every SF scenario) is dropped.
